---
name: Bug report
about: Wrong results, crashes or other unexpected solver behavior
---

### Problem
What goes wrong?

### Reproduction
A small model or script, the exact command or API calls, and any non-default
settings. For solver behavior, run with `--debug=<directory>` and attach the
zipped directory (see docs/DebuggingSHOT.md).

### Expected and actual behavior
What should happen and why (for example a known feasible point or an earlier
SHOT version that worked), and what happens instead: objective value, bounds
and termination status.

### Environment
SHOT version or commit, installation method (pip, binary, source build), OS,
and the MIP and NLP solvers with their versions.
